description: Precision control: a page of an application (menu, breadcrumb, dashboard tiles, a table with a numbered column, tabs, product cards, tags, pagination, a form with numbered options, a feed, a code block, footer columns) where everything that is a list is marked up as one. Nothing is fail, likely or advisory. The only findings are the inventory of real lists without markers that Safari would not expose: those outside navigation and without an explicit role.
